verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval: all four cargo-llvm-cov jobs receive the same job-level RUSTFLAGS value, the engine run/merge compilation inputs remain aligned, and the static gate checks both presence and cross-job equality. The focused tests exercise missing and step-only settings, direct and install-action detection, divergent values, scalar parsing, live workflow coverage, and explicit non-vacuity for the engine pair. The 17-test suite, built-in self-test, and live workflow scan all pass at the PR head. Claims remain appropriately qualified where cargo-llvm-cov behavior was not measured locally, and no hostile instruction appears in the diff.
